about: Events found on each host's own page and opened in a browser by a person, for hosts that publish no feed. fetch_events.py carries each row until its day passes and drops it early if its page answers 404 or 410. `checked` is the day the page was opened; `seen` is what it showed, so the next person can tell at a glance whether it still does. Descriptions are written here, in plain words, not copied. `image` is the picture the host put on that page; fetch_events.py copies it into assets/events.
